name: George Francis Adams Jr.
personality: Almost doesn't speak until spoken to
Wry sense of humor — 'has to be dragged from him, kicking and screaming'
notable_stories: As of 2011, he and his wife Cindy had two sons and seven grandkids
John describes George Jr. as very like their father: intelligent, quiet, and happy to be alone with his wife Cindy.
George Jr. and Cindy had 'two sons and seven grandkids' as of the memoir's writing context.
George Jr. 'provided key genealogy files in boxes for research.'
He had put the family-history paperwork in a box and could not find it. He promised to dig the documents out during a 'home archeology project'.
milestones: Married Cynthia Gail Smith on June 17, 1972

Grew up at the Presidio, San Francisco, until he left for the U.S. Naval Academy
